_metadata.title: Usage periods demo
_metadata.description: Minimal demo preset that exercises every OfferingComponent.limit_period (MONTH, QUARTERLY, ANNUAL, TOTAL) and both billing_types (limit, usage) so the per-offering /components-usage/ endpoint and the Customer/Project dashboard usage widget can be verified end-to-end. Includes six months of historic ComponentUsage so quarterly/annual/total aggregations differ from the current-month value, plus a 10-project distribution to support the by-project decomposition and crosses-limit projection demos.
scenarios: Mixed limit and usage billing on same dashboard
By-project decomposition (10 projects share one offering) — supports the by-project chart and 'View all' modal
Crosses-limit projection — quarterly compute offering at 87% of limit at end of May with linear forward rate that crosses cap in mid-June
